The 1948–49 season was [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol's 46th season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga|17th consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
During summer Bernabeu reinforced the team with several players including young star midfielder [[:es:Pablo Olmedo Garmendia|Pablo Olmedo]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/atletico-madrid/20190620/463010733379/llorente-el-duodecimo-que-pinta-rojo-en-la-camiseta-blanca.html|work=Marca|location=Spain|title=Llorente el 12th who painted red on his shirt|language=Spanish|date=20 July 2019|accessdate=15 July 2020}}</ref> midfielder [[Miguel Muñoz]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.trescuatrotres.com/miguel-munoz-mucho-mas-que-flor/|publisher=trescuatrtres.com|title=Miguel Muñoz, more than a Flower|language=Spanish|date=9 October 2017|accessdate=15 July 2020}}</ref> and top goalscorer [[Pahiño]] came from [[Celta Vigo]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.marca.com/2012/06/12/futbol/equipos/real_madrid/1339501563.html|title=Pahiño passed away, historic Spanish goalscorer|date=12 June 2012|accessdate=15 July 2020|work=Marca|location=Spain}}</ref> and midfielder [[:es:Jesus Narro|Jesus Narro]] was bought from [[Real Murcia]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.arandaarquitectos.com/websporting/index52.html|title=Temporada 5253|publisher=arandaarquitectos.com|date=24 January 2020|accessdate=15 July 2020}}</ref> In the [[1948–49 La Liga|league]] the squad reached the first spot after ten matchdays, but then collapsed to ultimately finish in the 3rd spot. New arrival forward [[Pahiño]] played in a superb form scoring 21 goals. In June, the club advanced to the [[1948–49 Copa del Generalísimo]] [[1948–49 Copa del Generalísimo#Round of 16|round of 16]] where they were defeated by [[Athletic Bilbao|Atletico de Bilbao]] in a playoff game after two draws.
